subject: ENGLISH
title: இன்றைய தேர்வு: Poem: The Two Pigeons || கவிதை: இரண்டு புறாக்கள் & Unit 2: Sports || அலகு 2: விளையாட்டு

quiz.q: What was the colour of the two pigeons in the story?
quiz.ex: The story begins by introducing two white pigeons who were friends.

quiz.q: Where did the pigeons rest during the afternoons?
quiz.ex: During afternoons, they would rest on their favourite tree in the forest.

quiz.q: What did the pigeons do before they went to sleep at night?
quiz.ex: Soon, it would be night, they would lock their wings and sleep.

quiz.q: How was the weather in the forest one day?
options: It was very hot and sunny
It was a windy autumn day
quiz.ex: One day it was raining heavily in the forest.

quiz.q: Who reached the tree first when it started raining?
quiz.ex: The hen-pigeon ran to the tree to escape the rain and started waiting for her friend.

quiz.q: What did the hen-pigeon do to remove the water from her body?
options: She ruffled her feathers and shook her body
She flew fast in the wind
quiz.ex: She ruffled her feathers and shook her body to remove the water.

quiz.q: Why was the hen-pigeon worried while sitting on the tree?
quiz.ex: The cock-pigeon was late due to the rain, so she whispered, 'He is never so late. I hope he is safe.'

quiz.q: Why did the cock-pigeon perch on a tree before reaching home?
options: To wait till the heavy rain stopped
quiz.ex: He thought, 'Ah! The rain is heavy let me wait in this tree till it stops.'

quiz.q: Who was standing nearby when the cock-pigeon perched on the tree?
quiz.ex: He did not know there was a bird catcher nearby.

quiz.q: How did the bird catcher catch the cock-pigeon?
options: He silently reached near and clamped him
He threw a large net over the tree
quiz.ex: The bird catcher silently reached near the pigeon and CLAMPED! He had caught the pigeon.

quiz.q: What was the immediate reaction of the cock-pigeon when he was caught?
options: He tried to fly and flutter in vain
quiz.ex: The pigeon tried to fly and flutter in vain, then he was tensed and fainted.

quiz.q: Where did the hunter place the caught pigeon?
quiz.ex: The hunter put the pigeon in his cage and started to walk home.

quiz.q: Why did the bird catcher take cover under the hen-pigeon's tree?
options: The sky thundered and it rained heavily
quiz.ex: The sky thundered and the bird catcher took cover under her tree to escape the rain.

quiz.q: What did the hen-pigeon do to get a closer look at the bird catcher's cage?
options: She flew down to the lowest branch
quiz.ex: She had to hide, but wanted a closer look, so she flew down to the lowest branch.

quiz.q: Why did the bird catcher decide to camp under the tree for the night?
options: It was too dark and late in the night
He was waiting for his friend
quiz.ex: Soon it stopped raining, but it was too dark and late in the night to walk home.

quiz.q: How did the bird catcher feel during the night?
quiz.ex: It was a wet and cold night, and the man was shivering and hungry.

quiz.q: Why couldn't the bird catcher start a fire initially?
options: He did not know how to make a fire
He could not find any dry twigs
quiz.ex: He wanted to start a fire to keep himself warm but he could not find any dry twigs.

quiz.q: What woke up the pigeon in the cage?
quiz.ex: The pigeon in the cage woke up and tried to fly only for his wings to hit the cage.

quiz.q: Who said, 'We have a guest now. The man is shivering and hungry. He needs your help.'?
quiz.ex: The trapped cock-pigeon said this to the crying hen-pigeon to comfort her and show hospitality.

quiz.q: What did the hen-pigeon gather to help the bird catcher?
quiz.ex: She made a big heap of dry twigs and got flintstones for the bird catcher to start the fire.

quiz.q: How many twigs did the hen-pigeon get at a time?
quiz.ex: She got two or three twigs at a time and made a big heap.

quiz.q: What was the purpose of the flintstones?
quiz.ex: She got flintstones for the bird catcher to start the fire.

quiz.q: What ultimate sacrifice did the hen-pigeon offer to the bird catcher?
options: She promised to guide him home
She offered to jump into the fire so he could eat her
She gave him all her winter food
quiz.ex: She said, 'I have no food to give you. I will jump into this fire so that you can eat me.'

quiz.q: How did the bird catcher react to the hen-pigeon's offer?
options: He was overwhelmed by her hospitality and stopped her
He caught her and put her in the cage
quiz.ex: The bird catcher was overwhelmed by the hospitality. He caught her and stopped her from jumping.

quiz.q: What did the hen-pigeon ask the bird catcher to do in return?
quiz.ex: She requested, 'Please set my friend free. My life will be meaningless without him.'

quiz.q: What did the bird catcher realize after the pigeons' kind act?
options: He realized he was cruel and selfish
He realized he should buy a better cage
He realized the forest is dangerous
quiz.ex: He said, 'I was cruel and selfish. I will never trap any bird again.'

quiz.q: What did the pigeons give the bird catcher in the morning?
quiz.ex: In the morning, the pigeons got him nuts, fruits and seeds to eat.

quiz.q: In the supplementary story, what did the elephant have?
quiz.ex: An elephant had a small piece of land where she grew vegetables and fruits.

quiz.q: Why did the forest look brown one summer?
options: Because it was dry as it did not rain
quiz.ex: One summer, the forest was dry, as it did not rain. All trees and plants were dry.

quiz.q: How many watermelons did the elephant manage to grow during the dry summer?
quiz.ex: The elephant somehow got water for just one watermelon plant which had only one watermelon.

quiz.q: Who came in search of food to the elephant's garden?
quiz.ex: A rabbit who had three babies came there in search of food.

quiz.q: Why did the elephant give her only watermelon to the rabbit?
options: She took pity the moment she saw the babies
She had plenty of other fruits
quiz.ex: The moment the elephant saw her babies, she took pity and gave the watermelon.

quiz.q: What is the main idea of the Elephant and Watermelon story?
options: During difficult times, we should save for ourselves
If we help someone, we will receive twice in return
quiz.ex: The moral highlights that helping others in need brings back greater rewards (the rain filled her garden the next day).

quiz.q: True or False: The pigeon started to worry for her friend.
quiz.ex: Yes, when the rain poured and he was late, the hen-pigeon started to worry.

quiz.q: True or False: The bird catcher's clothes were dry.
quiz.ex: False. It was a wet night and the man was shivering, indicating his clothes were wet.

quiz.q: True or False: The bird catcher let the pigeon jump into the fire.
quiz.ex: False. He caught the hen pigeon and stopped her from jumping into the fire.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank: The pigeon returned home when it started to _______.
quiz.ex: It started raining heavily, so she returned to her tree.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank: The bird catcher had a pigeon in his _______.
quiz.ex: The hunter put the pigeon in his cage.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank: The hen-pigeon got dry _______ for the bird catcher.
quiz.ex: The pigeon flew from the tree in search of dry twigs.

quiz.q: Identify the speaker: 'I hope he is safe.'
quiz.ex: The hen-pigeon whispered this while waiting for her friend.

quiz.q: Identify the speaker: 'Do not feel sad dear.'
quiz.ex: The trapped cock-pigeon told his friend not to cry but to help the guest.

quiz.q: Identify the speaker: 'I will camp here for the night.'
quiz.ex: The bird catcher thought this because it was too dark and late to go home.

quiz.q: Identify the speaker: 'Oh no! What shall I do now?'
quiz.ex: The hen-pigeon worried when she saw her friend inside the catcher's cage.

quiz.q: Identify the speaker: 'I was cruel and selfish.'
quiz.ex: The bird catcher realized his mistake after seeing the pigeon's extreme hospitality.

quiz.q: What is the correct suffix for the word 'colour'?
quiz.ex: The correct suffix is 'ful', making the word 'colourful'.

quiz.q: What is the correct suffix for the word 'thank'?
quiz.ex: The correct suffix is 'ful', making the word 'thankful'.

quiz.q: What is the correct suffix for the word 'retire'?
quiz.ex: The correct suffix is 'ment', making the word 'retirement'.

quiz.q: What is the correct suffix for the word 'drive'?
quiz.ex: The correct suffix is 'er', making the word 'driver'.

quiz.q: Choose the correct form for the present perfect tense: They ______ (start) playing.
quiz.ex: For the plural pronoun 'They', the present perfect uses 'have' + past participle 'started'.

quiz.q: Choose the correct form for the present perfect tense: She ______ (write) a letter.
quiz.ex: For the singular pronoun 'She', the present perfect uses 'has' + past participle 'written'.

quiz.q: Analogy Question - Bird Catcher : Cage :: Pigeon : ?
quiz.ex: A bird catcher uses a cage to stay/trap, while a pigeon uses a tree to live/rest.

quiz.q: Analogy Question - Cruel : Bird Catcher :: Hospitable : ?
quiz.ex: The bird catcher was initially cruel, whereas the hen-pigeon demonstrated extreme hospitality.

quiz.q:
Assertion (A): The bird catcher stayed under the tree for the entire night. 
Reason (R): He was invited by the pigeons to stay.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.
quiz.ex: He stayed because it was dark, raining, and late, not because he was invited. The hospitality came later.

quiz.q:
Assertion (A): The hen-pigeon decided to jump into the fire. 
Reason (R): She wanted to offer herself as food to the hungry guest.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.
quiz.ex: Since she had no food to offer the shivering and hungry guest, she offered her own life as food, fulfilling her duty of hospitality.

quiz.q: Real-life Scenario: If a poor, shivering traveler knocks on your door during a stormy night, what does this lesson teach you to do?
options: Ignore them and lock the door
Show hospitality by offering warmth and whatever food you have
Ask them to pay money for staying
Scold them for travelling in the rain
quiz.ex: The lesson 'Hospitality' teaches us to treat guests with kindness and help them in their time of need.

quiz.q:
Match the following based on the story: 
1. Twigs 
2. Flintstones 
3. Nuts 

A. Morning breakfast 
B. Start a fire 
C. Make a heap
quiz.ex: Twigs were made into a heap (1-C), flintstones were used to start the fire (2-B), and nuts were given as breakfast (3-A).

quiz.q: What is the meaning of the word 'overwhelmed' as used in the passage?
options: To fly very high in the sky
To feel very angry and violent
To sleep deeply without waking up
quiz.ex: The bird catcher was deeply moved emotionally (overwhelmed) by the pigeon's self-sacrifice.

quiz.q: Which action shows the true meaning of 'Hospitality' in the story?
options: The bird catcher trapping the pigeon
The hen-pigeon risking her life to feed a hungry guest
The cock-pigeon fainting in the net
quiz.ex: Hospitality is defined by the generous and selfless reception of guests, which the hen-pigeon demonstrated.

quiz.q: Find the odd one out from the context of the story's message:
quiz.ex: Kindness, hospitality, and generosity are positive traits shown by the pigeons, whereas selfishness is the negative trait the bird catcher gave up.

quiz.q: What was the ultimate reward the hen-pigeon received for her extreme hospitality?
options: She was eaten by the bird catcher
She became the queen of the forest
quiz.ex: Because of her hospitality, the bird catcher's heart melted, and he opened the cage to set her friend free.

quiz.q: What two things did Akilan consider as his 'two eyes'?
quiz.ex: Akilan was an active boy who liked sports as much as his studies, treating them like his two eyes.

quiz.q: When did Akilan usually spend his time on studies?
quiz.ex: Remembering his father's words, Akilan used to spend his mornings on studies and his evenings in the playground.

quiz.q: What was the memorable advice given by Akilan's father?
quiz.ex: His father always advised him saying, 'Learn well, live well!'

quiz.q: Who served as Akilan's inspiration to learn Judo?
options: His master at the Judo school
quiz.ex: His physical education teacher, who was good at Judo, was his inspiration.

quiz.q: Why was Akilan initially afraid to tell his parents about his interest in Judo?
options: He thought Judo was too expensive
He feared his parents would be upset
He had failed in his exams
He was afraid of getting injured
quiz.ex: He was afraid that his growing passion and interest in Judo would upset his parents.

quiz.q: How did Akilan's parents react when he finally showed them his sports medals and certificates?
quiz.ex: His parents were astonished (very surprised) on seeing the medals and certificates that he had won in school.

quiz.q: What tragedy struck Akilan a few months later?
options: He lost his left hand in an accident
His parents moved to another town
quiz.ex: After a few months, in an unfortunate accident, Akilan lost his left hand.

quiz.q: How did the accident affect Akilan initially?
options: He used to sit in a corner and did not go out often
He became very angry at his friends
quiz.ex: After losing his hand, from that day onwards he did not go out of the house often and used to sit in a corner.

quiz.q: Where did Akilan's father come across the advertisement for a Judo school?
quiz.ex: His father showed an advertisement of a Judo school that he came across in a newspaper.

quiz.q: How did the father react when Akilan asked if he could join the Judo school?
options: He got him admitted with tears of joy
He told him to wait for a year
He asked him to choose studies instead
quiz.ex: His father, with tears of joy, got him admitted to the Judo school because they were keen to fulfill their son's passion.

quiz.q: What did the Judo master teach Akilan first?
quiz.ex: The master trained him the basics before teaching the advanced skills.

quiz.q: For how long did Akilan practice consistently in the Judo school?
quiz.ex: Akilan learnt and practiced consistently for two years.

quiz.q: Why was Akilan surprised and annoyed during his training?
options: The master charged too much fee
The master taught him only a single stroke for two years
He was not allowed to participate in matches
quiz.ex: Akilan was annoyed because his master taught him and made him practice only a single stroke for two years.

quiz.q: What major event was Akilan picked for by his master?
quiz.ex: To everyone's surprise, Akilan was picked by the master for the 'National Judo Competition'.

quiz.q: Why did everyone ridicule Akilan and his master?
options: Because they were not sure how a boy with one hand could win a national competition
Because the master was not famous
Because they didn't have proper uniforms
quiz.ex: People ridiculed (teased) them as they doubted how a boy with only one arm could possibly win in a national level competition.

quiz.q: How many contenders did Akilan easily defeat to reach the finals?
quiz.ex: To everyone's surprise, Akilan easily defeated all his six contenders with his single stroke.

quiz.q: How many total rounds were there in the final match?
quiz.ex: The final match began, and it had a total of six rounds.

quiz.q: What happened in the first two rounds of the final match?
quiz.ex: The opponent was very strong and defeated Akilan easily in the first two rounds.

quiz.q: What valuable advice did the master give Akilan when the referee blew the whistle?
options: "Believe yourself. The key to success is to focus on your strengths and not your weakness."
quiz.ex: The master rushed to him and told him to focus on his strengths rather than his weakness.

quiz.q: How did the final match conclude for Akilan?
options: He lost by a narrow margin
He scored four strokes and four knockouts, winning the finals
quiz.ex: Feeling new energy, Akilan scored four strokes and four knockouts, becoming the champion.

quiz.q: What was the secret behind Akilan's victory with that single stroke?
options: To beat him, the opponent had to hold his left hand, which he did not have
quiz.ex: The master explained that he taught him the most difficult stroke, and the only defense against it required holding his left hand.

quiz.q: Pictionary: What is a 'Gourd'?
options: A large vegetable with hard skin
quiz.ex: According to the pictionary, a gourd is a large vegetable with hard skin.

quiz.q: Pictionary: What is 'Judo'?
options: A sport where one tries to unbalance the opponents using arms and legs
A game played with a ball and a bat
quiz.ex: Judo is a martial art sport where one unbalances opponents using arms and legs.

quiz.q: Pictionary: What does 'Victory' mean?
quiz.ex: Victory means winning against an opponent.

quiz.q: Pictionary: Who is an 'Archer'?
options: A person who shoots with bow and arrows
A person who judges a match
quiz.ex: An archer is defined as a person who shoots with a bow and arrows.

quiz.q: Pictionary: What is the meaning of 'Audience'?
options: People who come together to watch something
quiz.ex: Audience refers to the people who come together to watch an event or performance.

quiz.q: Glossary: What is the meaning of the word 'passion'?
quiz.ex: Passion means having a strong emotion or deep interest in something.

quiz.q: Glossary: What does 'inspiration' mean?
options: Mentally stimulated to do something creative
quiz.ex: Inspiration means being mentally stimulated to do something creative or great.

quiz.q: Glossary: The word 'wondered' means...
options: To think with a feeling of surprise
quiz.ex: Wondered means to think about something with a feeling of surprise.

quiz.q: Glossary: What is the meaning of 'excel'?
quiz.ex: Excel means to be exceptionally good at a particular activity or subject.

quiz.q: Glossary: The word 'ridiculed' means...
quiz.ex: Ridiculed means to be teased or mocked by others.

quiz.q: Book Back Choose: His father wanted him to do well in ______.
quiz.ex: According to the book back exercise, his father always emphasized studies ('Learn well, live well!').

quiz.q: Book Back Choose: Akilan's passion is to learn ______.
quiz.ex: Akilan's greatest passion was learning Judo.

quiz.q: Book Back Choose: Master trained Akilan on a ______.
quiz.ex: The master trained him specifically on a single stroke for two years.

quiz.q: Book Back Choose: Akilan learnt Judo for ______.
quiz.ex: Akilan learnt and practiced consistently for two years.

quiz.q: Book Back Identify the Speaker: "Believe yourself."
quiz.ex: The Master said these words to encourage Akilan during the final match.

quiz.q: Book Back Identify the Speaker: "Learn well, live well!"
quiz.ex: This was the advice given by Akilan's father.

quiz.q: Book Back Identify the Speaker: "How did I win the competition with a single stroke?"
quiz.ex: Akilan asked this out of curiosity after winning the championship.

quiz.q: Book Back Identify the Speaker: "My dear, you learnt the most difficult stroke in Judo."
quiz.ex: The Master explained the secret of the victory to Akilan.

quiz.q: Grammar Synonyms: What is a word with the same meaning as 'angry'?
quiz.ex: Angry and furious have similar meanings.

quiz.q: Grammar Synonyms: Find the synonym for 'happy'.
quiz.ex: Happy, joy, and glad denote the same feeling.

quiz.q: Grammar Synonyms: What word has the same meaning as 'cut'?
quiz.ex: Cut and chop are synonyms.

quiz.q: Grammar Synonyms: What is a synonym for 'slim'?
quiz.ex: Slim and thin give the same meaning.

quiz.q: Grammar Synonyms: In the sentence 'I ate the big apple', which word can replace 'big'?
quiz.ex: Big and large are words with similar meanings.

quiz.q: Grammar Synonyms: In the sentence 'This is a little dog', which word can replace 'little'?
quiz.ex: Little and small give the same meaning.

quiz.q: Grammar Synonyms: In the sentence 'I threw a rock in the lake', which word can replace 'rock'?
quiz.ex: Rock and stone have similar meanings.

quiz.q: Grammar Antonyms: What is the opposite of 'happy'?
quiz.ex: Happy is the opposite of sad.

quiz.q: Grammar Antonyms: What is the opposite of 'tall'?
quiz.ex: Tall is the opposite of short.

quiz.q: Grammar Antonyms: What is the opposite of 'full'?
quiz.ex: Full is the opposite of empty.

quiz.q: Grammar Antonyms: If a room is not 'dark', then it is ______.
quiz.ex: The opposite of dark is bright or light.

quiz.q: Grammar Antonyms: Is he standing on the 'top'? No, he is standing at the ______.
quiz.ex: The opposite of top is bottom.

quiz.q:
Assertion (A): Everyone ridiculed Akilan and his master when he was selected for the National Competition.
Reason (R): They were not sure how a boy with one hand could win against normal competitors.
options: A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
Both A and R are false
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
quiz.ex: People mocked them because they couldn't believe a one-armed boy could win a national championship.

quiz.q: Life-situation (HOTS): A student is very good at math but struggles with drawing. According to the master's advice to Akilan, what should the student do to succeed in life?
options: Focus on improving drawing all day and ignore math
Focus on the strength (math) to excel, rather than worrying only about the weakness
Complain about not knowing how to draw
quiz.ex: The master's key to success is: 'Focus on your strengths and not your weakness.'

quiz.q:
Match the Quotes with Speakers: 1) Believe yourself 2) Learn well, live well! 3) How did I win?
Select the correct sequence of speakers.
quiz.ex: Master said 'Believe yourself', Father said 'Learn well, live well!', and Akilan asked 'How did I win?'.

quiz.q: HOTS: Why was Akilan's weakness actually his greatest strength in the final match?
options: Because he was too young to be taken seriously
Because his opponent felt pity for him
Because the only defense against his stroke required the opponent to grab his left hand, which he didn't have
quiz.ex: His master cleverly taught him a move where the only counter-attack relied on grabbing the left hand, making Akilan unbeatable.

quiz.q: Which of the following traits best describes the Judo Master?
quiz.ex: The master was wise enough to turn Akilan's weakness into a strength and constantly encouraged him.

quiz.q: What is the core moral of the story 'The Strength in his Weakness'?
options: Never learn Judo if you are injured
Turn your weakness into your strength and believe in yourself
Only participate in sports if you have two hands
quiz.ex: The story beautifully conveys that with perseverance, one can turn their biggest weakness into their greatest strength.

quiz.q: Grammar Synonyms: Find a synonym for the word 'huge'.
quiz.ex: Huge means extremely large or big.

quiz.q: HOTS: What was the main reason Akilan initially felt annoyed with his master?
options: The master did not talk to him
The master made him practice a single stroke for two years while others learnt many
The master forced him to study
The master made him clean the school
quiz.ex: Akilan didn't understand the master's strategy initially and was frustrated doing the exact same stroke repeatedly for 2 years.

quiz.q: What did Akilan do to not upset his parents regarding his Judo passion before the accident?
options: He kept his passion a secret but finally showed them his medals to prove his dedication
He failed in his exams intentionally
quiz.ex: He was afraid to tell them but eventually told them and showed his medals to convince them.
